evidence.reason: The current tip's gitPushAtomic still builds `git push` with only `--atomic --porcelain --no-verify`, the leases, and the caller's refspecs, so the caller's explicit leased update set is not the only thing that can be published. When `push.followTags` is set in repository config (a global config is neutralized by the hardened child env, but repo-local config is not), git additionally pushes annotated tags reachable from the pushed commits that are absent on the remote. Those tags carry no `--force-with-lease` entry and bypass the update set the function's doc comment intends to enforce, so a governed push can publish refs the caller never leased or validated. Adding `--no-follow-tags` to the argv is the smallest compatible fix and preserves the existing behavior and API.
